releases.name: v2.1.0 — Claude-style automation
releases.body:
## Highlights
- AI checkpoints every 15 messages + pre-compaction emergency save (hooks decide *when*, model files via MCP)
- Synchronous exit save, per-project wings, `mine --extract general`
- Backfill mode (`OPENCODE_MEMPALACE_BACKFILL=1`), bundled `mempalace-recall` skill
- Robustness: interpreter probing (pipx/uv/PATH), no-timeout mines, shell-free spawns (`execFile`)
## Install
`npm i opencode-mempalace-persistence` + `mempalace` MCP server. See README.
